_comment: Experiment ledger (Tim 2026-10-26): hypothesis, channel, window, sample, result, decision. One line per experiment; append, never rewrite history. A concluded experiment needs a result and a kill/scale/iterate decision. Fed from the per-loop funnel report (scripts/lib/growth-registry.mjs loopFunnelReport).

hypothesis: Among qualified independent artists, a transparent signal-specific Jovie profile preview during a release window increases qualified activation within 14 days versus a no-contact holdout.
primaryMetric: claimed within 14 days of first touch

hypothesis: On /artist-profiles, leading with the owned fan list (v4) or the label-as-software analogy (v3) raises artist signups versus the current artist-profiles line (v1); offline panel round 1 (2026-11-01) ranked v4 > v3 > v1 on buyer personas.
primaryMetric: claim-start (content-record artist_signup step) per unique visitor, minimum 400 visitors and 20 signups per arm, one-sided two-proportion z >= 1.645
